title: Normal derivatives of the blow-ups are asymptotically nonpositive (Simon 3.4.3, proof of (9))
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^{m+1}, D ⊆ E, F ⊆ E Borel, μ a measure on E, ν : E → E Borel with |ν(z)| = 1 for every z, and assume (GG) ∫_F div φ dL^{m+1} = −∫⟨φ, ν⟩ dμ for every C¹ compactly supported φ : E → E with tsupport φ ⊆ D (div φ = trace Dφ). Let y, v ∈ E with |v| = 1 such that A(ρ) := μ(B̄_ρ(y))_ℝ^{-1} ∫_{B̄_ρ(y)} ν dμ → v as ρ ↓ 0 (μ(·)_ℝ = ENNReal.toReal, 0^{-1} = 0), and let ρ₁ > 0, C₁ ≥ 0 with B̄_{ρ₁}(y) ⊆ D and μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ C₁ρ^m for all 0 < ρ < ρ₁. Write F_{y,r} := {x : y + rx ∈ F}. Then for every C¹ compactly supported ζ : E → ℝ with ζ ≥ 0 and every δ > 0 there is r' > 0 such that ∫_{F_{y,r}} Dζ(z)(v) dL^{m+1}(z) ≤ δ for all 0 < r < r'.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ₁ C₁ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → ‖v‖ = 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → 0 < ρ₁ → 0 ≤ C₁ → closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₁ * ρ ^ m)) → ∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫ z in (fun z => y + r • z) ⁻¹' F, fderiv ℝ ζ z v ≤ δ
